# MDL015: mdl-shadow

| since | 2.0.0 |

A reference resolved to a nearer entity that shadows an outer one of the same name.

Shadowing is legal and reported; anchor the reference with a leading `::` to name the outer one.

## Examples

### MDL015 shadowing / A reference resolving to a nearer same-named entity fires #1 (line 6) (fire)

```text
grimble = "2";
module m;
node cli : trusted {
}
namespace api {
  node cli : trusted {
  }
  flow f : cli -> cli {
    label Public;
  }
}
```

### MDL015 shadowing / A reference anchored with :: is clean #2 (line 22) (clean)

```text
grimble = "2";
module m;
node cli : trusted {
}
namespace api {
  node inner : trusted {
  }
  flow f : ::cli -> inner {
    label Public;
  }
}
```
